newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Cyprus central bank defers decision on rate cut.
newsitem.headline: Cyprus central bank defers decision on rate cut.

text.p: The Central Bank of Cyprus on Thursday deferred a widely expected cut in commercial interest rates owing to "technicalities" which need to be clarified with banks, its governor said.

"No final decision was taken," Central Bank Governor Afxentis Afxentiou told Reuters after a two-hour meeting of the banks's board of directors. "There are certain technical problems which are to be discussed and the board will convene in about 15 days to take a decision," he added.
